scenes.text: Hello, little friends! I'm Chirpy Birdie, and I’m so excited to be with you today. We're going to have a fun chat about screen time and all the amazing things we can do together. Are you ready to flap your wings and explore with me? I promise it will be a chirpy and cheerful adventure. Let's get started, shall we?

Now, let's talk about what screen time means. Screen time is when we use devices like tablets, phones, or TVs to watch videos or play games. It's like when you watch your favorite cartoon or play a fun game. But did you know that too much screen time can make our eyes tired and our minds a little sleepy? That's why it's important to balance screen time with other activities.

Let's learn how to balance screen time with other fun things. We can set a timer to help us know when it's time to take a break. For example, after watching a show, we can go outside to play or read a book. Doing different activities helps our brains grow strong and keeps our bodies healthy. Isn't that wonderful?

Great job listening, friends! Now, let's practice taking a break together. Imagine you’ve just watched your favorite cartoon. What can we do next? Maybe we can go on a little adventure in the backyard or build a tower with blocks. Taking breaks helps us stay happy and full of energy. You can do it!

Remember when we talked about setting a timer? Let's think about how long we should spend on screens. A good idea is to spend about 20 minutes at a time before taking a break. After that, we can stretch, dance, or even sing a song. Balancing screen time with other activities makes every day fun and exciting!

Now, let's imagine we have a big list of fun activities to do. We can draw, play with toys, or even help with little chores like picking up toys. These activities are just as fun as screen time and help us learn new things. Can you think of some activities you love to do?

You're doing amazing! Let's try something together. How about we count to five while taking deep breaths? One, two, three, four, five. Breathing helps us feel calm and ready for the next adventure. Isn't it nice to relax for a moment?

Let's continue exploring the fun world outside of screens. We can play pretend games like being a superhero or a chef. Or maybe we can go on a treasure hunt looking for special leaves or rocks. The world is full of wonders just waiting for us to discover!

It's important to talk with our grown-ups about screen time. They can help us decide when to watch and when to play. Together, we can make a plan that includes both screen time and other fun activities. Working together makes everything more fun!

Do you have a favorite activity you like to do when you're not using screens? Maybe it's playing with a pet or drawing a picture. It's always fun to share our favorite things with friends. What do you think you might try next time you take a break?

Those are wonderful ideas! Now, let’s think about how we feel after playing outside or doing something creative. Do you feel happy and full of energy? Doing different activities helps us feel great and ready for more adventures. Let’s keep having fun!

Now that we've talked about balancing screen time, let's remember why it's important. Our eyes and brains need breaks to stay healthy. And exploring new activities helps us learn and grow. It makes every day an exciting journey we can enjoy together!

You're doing a fantastic job learning about screen time! Remember, it's okay to enjoy screens, but it's also fun to do many other things. Keep exploring and discovering new adventures every day. You are a little superstar!

Before we finish, let's think of one new activity to try today. Maybe it's learning a new song or building something with blocks. Whatever you choose, make sure to have fun and enjoy every moment. Trying new things makes us happy and curious!

It's time to say goodbye, little friends! Thank you for joining me, Chirpy Birdie, on this wonderful adventure about screen time. Remember to balance your day with many fun activities. I hope you have a chirpy and cheerful day ahead. Bye-bye, and see you soon!
